intro: Cinq 1500 Sideboard is made to move through changing spaces and routines. With versatile storage and a visually light form, it adapts beautifully beside seating areas, dining spaces, or under windows.

features.title: Versatile, modern design for evolving spaces
features.text: Cinq 1500 is designed to adapt effortlessly across interiors. Whether placed beside an armchair, along a dining wall, or beneath a window, its clean contemporary form integrates seamlessly into modern homes. Moreover, its balanced neutral palette creates a calm and refined visual presence that pairs effortlessly with varied decor styles.

features.title: Tubular steel frame for refined structural elegance
features.text: The slender tubular steel frame introduces an airy architectural quality while providing dependable strength and stability for everyday use.

features.title: Spacious storage for organised living
features.text: A thoughtful combination of hinged-door storage, drawers, and open compartments accommodates books, serveware, board games, throws, and everyday essentials with ease.

features.title: Elevated base for visual lightness
features.text: Raised on slender yet sturdy legs, the sideboard maintains an open and uncluttered appearance while allowing convenient floor cleaning underneath.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
